title: Derived test sections and canonical pullback restriction
statement: Fix shared derived-category localizations [def-pc-derived-category]. For a scheme W, E in D(O_W), and t:T→W [def-pc-derived-pullback], define P(E,t)=Hom(Lt*(O_W[0]),Lt*E), with its additive group structure. Given i:T′→T and h:i∘t=t′, let c:Li*Lt*≅Lt′* be the canonical composition comparison [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] followed by transport along h. Define r(E,i,t,t′,h)(ξ)=c(O_W[0]) inverse ∘ Li*(ξ) ∘ c(E). For w in an open V of W, let i_w,V:Spec κ(w)→V be the open immersion lift of W.fromSpecResidueField(w) [def-weil-residue-field]; its composite with V→W equals W.fromSpecResidueField(w).
